testcase.name: synthetic PCM traverses the real YIN and public round to a fourth
stale callbacks wrong phases and post closure input are ignored
imitation evaluates a fifth from the sung anchor regardless of register
a drifting attack must leave the full stable window before acquisition
transposing both sung notes does not change the interval
silence invalid frequencies and long gaps cannot bridge a hold
bounded telemetry interrupts without granting a completed round
descending octave and explicitly separated unison are playable
timeout during silence or between notes never invents a musical outcome
a stable wrong octave remains an error rather than being folded
